title: New bars: Ainslie Minted gold
body: Added the Ainslie Minted gold bar range (.9999 fine) in 1 g, 5 g, 10 g, 20 g, 1 oz, 50 g and 100 g — the own-brand minted line from Ainslie Bullion, the Brisbane dealer trading since 1974, each bar serial-numbered in a tamper-evident card. Open Add Holding → Gold → Bar to find them.

title: New coin: Austrian 1000 Schilling Babenberger
body: Added the Austrian 1000 Schilling Babenberger (13.5 g at .900 fine, 12.15 g of gold) — struck by the Austrian Mint in 1976 for the millennium of the Babenberg dynasty, with the heraldic eagle on the obverse and a mounted knight on the reverse. Open Add Holding → Gold → Coin to find it.

title: New coin: British Royal Arms
body: Added the Royal Mint's 1 oz Royal Arms silver bullion coin (.999 fine), issued annually since 2019 and carrying the full Royal Coat of Arms on the reverse — the Britannia's stablemate at the same 38.61 mm size. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find it.

title: New bars: Tavex 1 g gold, Asahi 1 oz silver
body: Added the Tavex 1 g gold bar (.9999 fine) from the Nordic and Baltic dealer, and the Asahi Refining 1 oz silver bar (.999 fine) from the Salt Lake City refiner that took over the old Johnson Matthey works. Open Add Holding → Gold or Silver → Bar to find them.

title: New bar: SilverTowne Flag
body: Added the SilverTowne Flag silver bar (.999 fine) in 1 oz, 5 oz and 10 oz — a minted bar from the Indiana refiner carrying the American flag design. Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find them.

title: New coin: Cook Islands 20 Dollars — 500 Years of America
body: Added the Cook Islands 20 Dollars gold proof (1/25 oz, .999 fine) from the 500 Years of America series, struck for the 500th anniversary of Columbus's voyage. The reverse varies by issue — Christopher Columbus, the Statue of Liberty and others — so record your design and year in the holding notes. Open Add Holding → Gold → Coin to find it.

title: New bar: Wessex Mint 1 g silver
body: Added the Wessex Mint 1 g silver bar (.999 fine) — a minted bar from the UK independent mint. Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find it.

title: New bars: Geiger & Karatbars 1 g gold
body: Added requested gold bars — the Geiger Edelmetalle gold bar (.9999, square security-line format, in 1 g through 1 kg) and the Karatbars 1 g gold bar (.9999). Open Add Holding → Gold → Bar to find them.

title: New coin: Silver Krugerrand
body: Added the 1 oz Silver Krugerrand (.999 fine) — struck by Rand Refinery and the South African Mint, sharing the classic Paul Kruger / springbok design of its famous gold sibling. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find it.

title: New bars: Argor-Heraeus Year of the Snake & Scottsdale Prepper
body: Added two requested bars — the Argor-Heraeus 'Year of the Snake 2025' gold limited edition (.9999, in 1 g / 5 g / 10 g / 1 oz), and the Scottsdale Mint 1 g 'Prepper' silver bar (.999). Open Add Holding → Bar to find them.

title: New bar: Patriots Coin 1 g gold snap bar
body: Added the Patriots Coin 1 gram gold snap bar (.9999) — a divisible bar that breaks into 15 grain sub-bars, with serial number and tamper-proof hologram. Open Add Holding → Gold → Bar to find it.

title: New bar: Argor-Heraeus Kinebar (gold)
body: Added the Argor-Heraeus Kinebar — the Swiss refiner's gold bar with the embedded Kinegram hologram, in 1 g, 2 g, 5 g, 10 g, 20 g, 1 oz, 50 g and 100 g (.9999 fine). It now has its own entries alongside the plain Argor-Heraeus bars. Open Add Holding → Gold → Bar to find them.

title: New bars: APMEX Lunar silver (full zodiac)
body: Added the full APMEX Lunar silver bar line (1 oz, .999 fine) — every Chinese zodiac year as its own entry: Series 1 from 2012 Year of the Dragon through 2023 Year of the Rabbit, plus the redesigned Series 2 (2024 Dragon, 2025 Snake, 2026 Horse). Each year carries its own reverse design. The plain APMEX bar stays for unthemed pieces. Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find them.

title: New: individual designs for beasts, lunar & wildlife series
body: Big collectible update — many series now have a catalogue entry per design instead of one generic row. Royal Mint Queen's Beasts and Tudor Beasts (all ten beasts each, silver 2 oz + gold 1 oz and 1/4 oz), Perth Mint Lunar Series II and III (every zodiac year), and the Royal Canadian Mint Wildlife and Birds of Prey series (each animal). The generic family entries remain for anything not separately listed. Open Add Holding → Silver/Gold → Coin to find them.

title: New bar: SilverTowne Liberty Buffalo 5 oz silver
body: Added the SilverTowne Liberty Buffalo 5 oz silver bar (.999 fine) — a tribute design to the classic American Buffalo Nickel, with a Native American profile on the obverse and the buffalo on the reverse. Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find it.

title: New bar: Perth Mint Dune 1 g gold
body: Added the Perth Mint Dune™ 1 g gold bar (.9999 fine) — an officially licensed Dune-themed minted bar featuring the sandworm of Arrakis on the obverse and the Perth Mint swan LBMA hallmark on the reverse. Limited mintage of 5,000 worldwide. Open Add Holding → Gold → Bar to find it.

title: New coin: Barbados Silver Trident
body: Added the Barbados Silver Trident 1 oz coin (.999 fine), struck by the Royal Canadian Mint for the Central Bank of Barbados. One catalogue entry covers the full annual series — running since 2017 — as all 1 oz issues share the same format. The design changes by year, so record your coin's year and design in the holding notes. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find it.

title: New bars: Nordic Mint Tree silver (1, 5, 10 oz, 1 kg)
body: Added the Nordic Mint Tree of Life silver bar family (.999 fine) — 1 oz, 5 oz, 10 oz, and 1 kg minted bars featuring the Yggdrasil tree from Norse mythology, struck by Nordic Mint in Fargo, North Dakota (ISO-9001 certified American private mint). Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find them.

title: New bar: SilverTowne Heritage Eagle 1 oz silver
body: Added the SilverTowne Heritage Eagle 1 oz silver bar (.999 fine) — a classic American-eagle minted bar from SilverTowne Mint. Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find it.

title: New bar: PAMP Barbie Series 1 g gold
body: Added the PAMP Suisse Barbie™ Series 1 g gold bar (.9999 fine). One catalogue entry covers the full Barbie series — starting with the 2025 Year 1 design — since all 1 g issues share the same PAMP minted format. The design changes by year, so record your bar's year and design in the holding notes. Open Add Holding → Gold → Bar to find it.

title: Catalog expansion: six new coin series
body: Big batch of new coin families added today: Royal Mint Queen's Beasts (silver 2/10 oz, 1 kg + gold 1/4, 1 oz, .9999) and its successor Tudor Beasts (same weights); Perth Mint Lunar Series II 2008–2019 (silver 1/2 oz to 1 kg + gold 1/10 to 1 oz, the predecessor to Series III); South African Big Five silver and gold 1 oz; and the Royal Canadian Mint Wildlife Series and Birds of Prey silver 1 oz. Each entry is generic — one row per weight covers every beast, animal, bird, or zodiac year in the series. Record the specific design and year in your holding notes. Open Add Holding to find them.

title: New coins: Chinese Silver Panda
body: Added the China Mint Silver Panda (.999 fine) — two entries cover the full bullion run: the pre-2016 1 oz issue (1989–2015) and the 2016+ 30 g metric issue. Both share the same 40 mm format. The reverse panda design changes every year, so record your coin's year in the holding notes. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find them.

title: New coins: Australian Silver Koala (Perth Mint)
body: Added the Perth Mint Silver Koala bullion family (.9999 fine) — 1/2 oz, 1 oz, 10 oz and 1 kg. The koala design changes every year (running 2007–present), so record your coin's year and design in the holding notes. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find them.

title: New bar: Scottsdale The Vortex 1 oz silver
body: Added the Scottsdale Mint The Vortex 1 oz silver bar (.999 fine) — a themed minted bar from Scottsdale's art-bar line (50 × 29 × 2.6 mm). Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find it.

title: New coin: Australian Lunar Series III silver (Perth Mint)
body: Added the Perth Mint Lunar Series III silver coin (1 oz, .9999 fine). One catalogue entry covers the whole 2020–2031 zodiac cycle — starting with the 2020 Year of the Mouse and continuing through to the 2031 Year of the Pig — since all 1 oz issues share the same 32.6 mm format. The reverse design changes by year, so record your coin's zodiac year in the holding notes. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find it.

title: New bar: Scottsdale Stacker 10 oz silver
body: Added the Scottsdale Mint Stacker 10 oz silver bar (.999 fine) — a serialized, interlocking rectangular bar built to stack flush. Note this is the bar format; the 1–5 oz Stacker rounds are listed separately under Coin. Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find it.

title: New coin: Australian Pixiu silver (Perth Mint)
body: Added the Perth Mint Pixiu silver coin (1 oz, .9999 fine). One catalogue entry covers the Pixiu series — including the 2020 Double Pixiu (Guardian Lions) — which share the same 40.6 mm format. The reverse design changes by year, so record your coin's year and design in the holding notes. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find it.

title: New version available — update
body: Head to the App Store or Google Play and grab the latest BullionView to see the features below. New in this release: real-world value math — premium + sell-spread (Pro), six built-in calculators, a help-and-explanations glossary, sell-spread management for Pro, and a way to create your own coin/bar specs.

title: Real-world value math (Pro)
body: BullionView 1.4 adds sell-value math for Pro accounts: see what your stack would actually fetch at dealer buy-back prices (spot minus a realistic spread), alongside the current value (spot plus each spec's premium). Pick which drives your dashboard headline in Settings → Portfolio value, or set it to plain Spot. Holding detail shows all three side by side. Free continues to see plain spot value.

title: Six built-in calculators + a help screen
body: A new Tools section on the dashboard opens six in-app calculators built for stackers: Effects, Buying Power, Dealer Premium, GSR Convert, Ratio Mean-Reversion, and (Pro) Portfolio What-If. Plus a Help & Explanations screen with plain-language definitions of spot, premium, sell spread, cost basis, current value and sell value — with concrete gold and silver worked examples.

title: Add your own coin or bar specs
body: No-name silver rounds, generic foundry bars, anything that isn't in the curated catalog — you can now create your own user-defined specs. Set the name, metal, weight, purity, dimensions and premium once, then re-use the spec across holdings just like any catalog entry. Multi-variant families let one spec cover several weights. Generate a QR code to share a spec with another BullionView user; they scan it straight into their library. Open Add Holding, pick a metal and coin/bar, and look for the YOUR SPECS section in the picker.

title: New coins: Scottsdale Stacker silver rounds
body: Added the Scottsdale Mint Stacker series in silver (.999 fine) — 1oz, 2oz, 100g, and 5oz. The Stacker line ships under multiple designs (Lion, Eagle, Dragon, and more) but the physical spec is identical across designs, so one catalogue entry per weight covers them all — record the specific design in your holding notes. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find them.

title: New coins: Morgan Silver Dollar (historical .900 + modern .999)
body: Added the iconic Morgan Silver Dollar in two flavours: the classic 1878–1921 issue (.900 fine, 0.7734 oz pure silver) and the 2021+ US Mint revival (.999 fine, 0.8585 oz pure silver). Same 26.73g coin, 38.1mm diameter — only the composition changed. Both are numismatic — value driven by year, mintmark, and condition, not silver content alone. Pick the right flavour when adding your holding and record year + mintmark + grade in the notes. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find them.

title: New coin series: Germania
body: Added the Germania coin series (.9999 fine), struck at Germania Mint — silver 1/10, 1/4, 1/2, 1 and 2 oz; gold 1/10, 1/4, 1/2 and 1 oz. Open Add Holding → Silver/Gold → Coin to find them.

title: New bars: Germania Mint silver cast + gold
body: Big Germania Mint catalog update — added the full silver cast bar range (1oz, 5oz, 10oz, 100oz, 100g, 250g, 500g, and 1kg in both .9999 and .999) plus a 1g gold minted bar and a 1oz gold cast bar. Open Add Holding to find them.

title: New coin family: Armenian Noah's Ark silver
body: Added the full Armenian Noah's Ark silver bullion family (.999 fine) — 1g, 1/4 oz, 1/2 oz, 1 oz, 5 oz, 10 oz, 1 kg and the 5 kg cast issue. Open Add Holding → Silver → Coin to find them.

title: New bar: Royal Mint Britannia 100g silver
body: Added the Royal Mint Britannia 100g silver minted bar (.999 fine). Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find it.

title: New bars: Geiger silver
body: Added the full Geiger Edelmetalle silver square-bar range (.999 fine) — 1g, 5g, 10g, 20g, 1oz, 50g, 100g, 5oz, 250g, 10oz, 500g, 1kg and the 5kg cast bar. Open Add Holding → Silver → Bar to find them.

title: New coin: Liberia 1/1000 oz gold
body: Added support for the Liberia 1/1000 oz gold coin series — covers Fall of Lucifer, Cannabis, Spartan, UFO and the rest of the themed line. Use the notes field on your holding to record the specific theme and year.

title: New bars: full Nadir range + more APMEX silver
body: Big catalog update — added 19 bars: the full Nadir Metal Rafineri minted gold range (1g, 2.5g, 5g, 10g, 20g, 50g, 100g, both .995 and .9999), Nadir silver (1oz, 50g, 100g), and APMEX silver (1oz, 5oz, 10oz). Open Add Holding to find them.

title: Welcome to News
body: This is where you'll see new bars, new coins, app features, and updates from the team. Tap the bell on the dashboard any time.
